card.name: Linking words before 'including' or 'approximately'
card.fires_on: A comma, 'of' or similar short linking word that comes right before a qualifying phrase. Most often the comma after 'deterioration of renal function', and 'of' after 'an increase'.

modes.label: Comma after renal function
modes.description: Comma after 'deterioration of renal function' in the NSAID and ACE inhibitor or ARB interaction warning, before 'including possible acute renal failure'.
modes.example: may result in deterioration of renal function<<,>> including possible acute renal failure.

modes.label: 'of' after increase
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'an increase' in the suicidal thinking statistics sentence.
modes.example: representing an increase<< of>> approximately one case of suicidal thinking or behavior

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Short linking words such as 'during' or 'direct' that come before a qualifying phrase in a warning sentence.
modes.example: especially<< during>> dosage initiation and escalation of BYETTA

card.plain: It fires on small linking words and commas that come just before a phrase adding detail in warning sentences.
